description: The plans on sale for a destination, with data, validity, networks and price in the requested currency. Unlimited plans give a daily amount at full speed, then a reduced speed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for prices, e.g. EUR, GBP, JPY. Defaults to USD.

destination_id.description: Destination id from search_destinations, e.g. "jp" or "eu-42".

language.description: Language of the buy link and of region names: en, it, es, fr, de, pl, pt, tr. Defaults to en.

type.description: Only fixed data plans, only unlimited day passes, or all. Defaults to all.

name: list_plans
title: List eSIM plans
